title: Grade 8 INTEGRATED SCIENCE — Reproduction in human beings (Screen Drama)
body:
EPISODE PACKAGE
====

EPISODE TITLE: THE QUIET QUESTION
SUBJECT / TOPIC: INTEGRATED SCIENCE / Reproduction in human beings
GRADE: Grade 8 JSS
AGE RATING: 10+ (student-safe)
DURATION: 8 minutes
VISUAL STYLE: naturalistic live-action look with clear prop inserts (or 2D/3D cartoon adaptation of the same blocking)

LEARNING TIE-IN: Replace myths with accurate menstrual-cycle science and care steps

LOGLINE: A learner facing painful periods gets scientific, respectful guidance instead of myths from the hallway.

WORLD & CAST
----
• Setting / era: INT. school counselor corner / clinic waiting bench
• Amina: Grade 8 learner seeking help. Costume: uniform, sweater.
• Nurse Atieno: school health nurse. Costume: nurse tunic.
• Purity: well-meaning friend with myths. Costume: uniform.

SCREENPLAY
----

SCENE 1 — EXT./INT. OPENING LOCATION — DAY
----
ACTION: Amina enters the world of the story with a clear goal: Replace myths with accurate menstrual-cycle science and care steps. Camera follows hands and faces, not a chalkboard.

Amina
If I can just get this right today, everything else will fall into place.

Nurse Atieno
Then stop guessing. Show me what you think is happening.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Wide establishing → medium two-shot. Ambient authentic location SFX. Soft hopeful underscore.

SCENE 2 — SAME / NEARBY — DAY
----
ACTION: Obstacle appears. Stakes rise. Props related to the science idea are handled as real objects, not lecture aids.

Amina
It looks simple. Watch me do it the usual way.

Purity
If you are wrong, we lose time — and maybe more than time.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Close-ups on props and worried eyes. Tension riser.

Amina
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

Nurse Atieno
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 3 — CONFRONTATION — DAY
----
ACTION: WRONG WAY: Purity repeats unsafe myths about “holding periods” and shame. The problem worsens. Meaning stays in action and argument — characters never read notes aloud.

Amina
See? I did what everyone does.

Nurse Atieno
And it got worse. That means your idea about it is incomplete.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Handheld urgency. Cut to the failed result.

SCENE 4 — DISCOVERY — DAY/NIGHT
----
ACTION: A clue appears through action — a label, a measurement, a safer method, a remembered rule spoken as dialogue while doing.

Nurse Atieno
Look at what actually changed. Name it properly.

Amina
Wait… if that is true, then I was measuring the wrong thing.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Insert shots of evidence. Music shifts from tension to curiosity.

Amina
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

Nurse Atieno
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 5 — SECOND ATTEMPT — DAY
----
ACTION: RIGHT WAY: Nurse Atieno explains cycle stages, hygiene, and when to see a clinician. Characters perform the corrected action step by step.

Amina
This time we follow the rule, not the rumour.

Purity
I can see the difference already.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Cleaner framed shots; success micro-beats.

SCENE 6 — COMPLICATION — DAY
----
ACTION: A new obstacle or time pressure forces them to apply the idea again, proving it was not luck.

Purity
We are not done. Another problem just arrived.

Nurse Atieno
Same science. Fresh situation. Go.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Parallel cut or ticking clock motif without graphic peril.

Amina
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

Nurse Atieno
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 7 — RESOLUTION — DAY
----
ACTION: Payoff: goal achieved. Characters show the result; still no voice-over lecture.

Amina
It worked because we used the idea correctly — not because we pushed harder the same wrong way.

Nurse Atieno
Say the reason in your own words before we pack up.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Warm wider shot; relieved faces; result hero insert.

SCENE 8 — BUTTON — DAY
----
ACTION: Final acted beat tying emotion to the learning without reading notes aloud.

Purity
Next time someone guesses, we will ask for the reason.

Amina
And we will check the evidence first.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Slow push-in; music resolves.

Amina
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

Nurse Atieno
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

BOOKENDS
----
• COLD OPEN (max 10s): Quick hook image of the failed first attempt — then cut to title THE QUIET QUESTION.
• CLOSING REFLECTION CARD (max 10s): On-screen question — Why should learners use scientific sources for reproductive health? Answer must match lesson solutions (Myths can harm; accurate terms guide safe care).

CAPTIONS
----
Amina: If I can just get this right today, everything else will fall into place.
Nurse Atieno: Then stop guessing. Show me what you think is happening.
Amina: It looks simple. Watch me do it the usual way.
Purity: If you are wrong, we lose time — and maybe more than time.
Amina: See? I did what everyone does.
Nurse Atieno: And it got worse. That means your idea about it is incomplete.
Nurse Atieno: Look at what actually changed. Name it properly.
Amina: Wait… if that is true, then I was measuring the wrong thing.
Amina: This time we follow the rule, not the rumour.
Purity: I can see the difference already.
Purity: We are not done. Another problem just arrived.
Nurse Atieno: Same science. Fresh situation. Go.
Amina: It worked because we used the idea correctly — not because we pushed harder the same wrong way.
Nurse Atieno: Say the reason in your own words before we pack up.
Purity: Next time someone guesses, we will ask for the reason.
Amina: And we will check the evidence first.

ASSET LIST
----
• Characters: Amina, Nurse Atieno, Purity
• Costumes: as listed above
• Locations: INT. school counselor corner / clinic waiting bench
• Props: topic-authentic objects for Reproduction in human beings
• Key shots: failed attempt insert, evidence insert, successful payoff insert

Study pages available for fidelity: 20
DRAMA NOTE: No voice-over of lesson notes. Meaning travels through action and in-character dialogue.
